info.name: Gas Queue API (نظام دور تعبئة الغاز)
info.description:
All REST endpoints of the simple (no-auth) NestJS API.

HOW TO RUN: start the API, then run the collection top to bottom (Runner) - every folder builds on the previous one. Test scripts save ids (agentId, dayId, ticketId, ...) into collection variables automatically.
To start a fresh demo run, delete the collection variable `runId` (and the ids) or re-import the collection.
